classification: pre-registered portfolio-level independent defensive-source screen; stock sleeves frozen
hypothesis: A commodity basket can provide an independent return source when gold is weak. Rotating only the existing one-third defensive alt slot between gold and a three-ETF commodity basket, while preserving the safe treasury+dividend fallback, may improve 2022-2026 returns and 5x net-profit breadth without changing equity selection.

fixed_construction.sleeve_risk_parity: three-sleeve 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity, raw weights bounded [0.20,0.60], C capped at 0.10, excess returned proportionally to A/B

defensive_bucket.commodity_basket_method: equal-weight buy-and-hold index normalized to 100 at the first common date; no internal rebalance-alpha assumption
defensive_bucket.signal: At month-end T close, each asset is ON when close > its own 200-trading-day simple moving average. Signal applies to subsequent returns only.
defensive_bucket.treasury_and_dividend_other_slots: unchanged equal third outside the alt slot

fixed_construction.vol_target: 60-day lookback, 15% annual target, gross exposure [0.20,1.00], monthly rebalance
fixed_construction.switch_cost: on every month-end state change deduct one-third of the overlay round-trip cost from the alt-slot return as a conservative full-slot turnover charge

selection_rule: Select the dual-trend alt-slot portfolio only if every preflight and performance gate passes. Otherwise selected=null and the commodity line closes without threshold or weight scans.
post_selection_rule: A pass would require a separate R358 robustness round covering parameter plateau, C-cap plateau, asset replacement and full cost stress before any paper-trading review.
